summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for CreatorForge iteration 2 (WCAG 2.2 AA a11y + expanded legal). All NEW features PASS: 5 legal doc routes render with title, effective date + working back button (privacy/terms/subscription/disclaimer/accessibility); Profile shows all 6 legal rows including Subscription Agreement + Accessibility Statement, each navigating correctly; Login inline validation errors render per-field for empty and invalid email/short password; Paywall shows Restore Purchases + Terms/Subscription/Privacy links, both plans ($14.99/mo & $149/yr) and Continue CTA; AI disclaimer text renders on Capture after refine and is coded on Brand Kit assets section. REGRESSION: demo login + dashboard (milestones + seeded projects + usage bar) works; Incubator shows search + 4 status chips (All/Ideas/Branding/Complete); Studio shows Lumen Coffee brand kit; Profile theme toggle flips Dark↔Light and re-renders without breakage; interactive elements remain tappable (chip tap-targets increased to 44dp visible in incubator). ONE MINOR REGRESSION: after tapping Log out on /profile, the auth token is cleared (localStorage cf_token=null) but the app does NOT redirect to /login — user stays on /profile. Also 2 pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents) still present (documented in iteration_1).

integration_issues.issue: Tapping the Log out button clears the auth token (localStorage cf_token becomes null) and calls api.logout(), but the UI remains on /profile inside the (tabs) stack instead of navigating to /login. Root cause: AuthContext.logout() only sets user=null; app/(tabs)/profile.tsx does not call router.replace('/login') after logout, and there is no auth-guard effect inside (tabs)/_layout.tsx watching user. The redirect in app/index.tsx only fires on initial mount. Fix: in profile.tsx onPress of the Log out Button (or in AuthContext.logout), call router.replace('/login') after await logout(); or add a useEffect in (tabs)/_layout.tsx that redirects when user becomes null.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.logout() clears state but does not trigger navigation; combined with (tabs) group not having an auth guard, this leaves stale authenticated UI visible after logout. Recommend an auth effect in (tabs)/_layout.tsx: useEffect(() => { if (!user && !loading) router.replace('/login'); }, [user, loading]).
Legal back button uses router.back() unconditionally — could no-op if deep-linked. Guard with router.canGoBack().

rca_of_issue: Logout regression RCA: In /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx the logout() function only calls api.logout(), setToken(null), and setUser(null). The Profile Log out Button in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx wires onPress directly to `logout` with no follow-up navigation. The redirect logic in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx only runs when that route mounts; because the user is still inside /(tabs)/profile after logout, no navigator re-runs the redirect. Reproduction: login → Profile → scroll → Log out → observe user remains on /profile with localStorage token cleared. Verified via headless Playwright: localStorage cf_token=null but page.url stayed on /profile. Mitigation: add router.replace('/login') after logout, or add useEffect guard in (tabs)/_layout.tsx.
